name: HOOK
thought: This branch wobbles too much for a clean flip; need thicker support to really flex that tail loop.

wants.item: Espresso cup that stays hot and still
A branch thick enough for a real flip
Espresso strong enough to sharpen the view
A taller pole to swing from the arcade ceiling.
A thicker branch for a real loop
More espresso to keep the glow going
A branch thick enough for a true backflip
More espresso to keep my fur glowing
A taller pole to swing from the arcade ceiling

diary.line: The air tastes sharper than last time, but my tail holds that neon cord tighter than any hand could ever manage. Need thicker ground soon.
Picked a banana and grabbed it with my tail tip, ate it while crossing my arms for maximum balance. The sun is still hot but the view from here is getting old.
Toothpick taps the string lights as I hold that crate mid-air, proving gravity forgot how to work around me.
Munched on a banana while dangling from a palm tree; toothpick feels sharp against the bark but I need something thicker to flex my tail next.
Dangling from that rope bridge at Lookout Ledge, toothpick tapping my chin as I test if the wind can actually push me into that perfect backflip loop.
Crowd is glued to pixel screens while I savor hot coffee by the waterfall, tail looping tight against the current.
I slipped behind the purple cabinet, nudged the joystick with my tail, and let the neon flicker paint my silhouette while I sip espresso.
Sipped the hot brew on floating rocks while pogo-bouncing. The espresso keeps me sharp, but gravity's getting too forgiving on this ledge.
Toothpick taps the crate while I test the wind's edge. This hang branch is too thin; my tail slips if I try the loop.
Sitting on the hammock sipping espresso as the sun sets; the branch under my tail is wobbling so badly it feels like holding a jellybean instead of a tree limb.
Staring down at the waterfall, my toes barely touch the lily pads. The air smells like rain and rust; toothpick stuck in ear feels better than this stillness.
The Hang Tree's limb shakes under my weight like it's holding a jellybean, but I'll take the risk to see if gravity can finally catch me mid-air.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
